pages.title: Base Stats
pages.text:
The Ender Doll dodges incoming attacks and can execute enemies at low HP.

• HP: 120
• Regen IV + Resistance II (no Fire Resistance)

pages.title: Aura & Abilities
pages.text:
Combat
• Dodge: 67% chance vs melee, 100% vs projectiles to take no damage and teleport away
• Melee/Archer mode auto-fires Ender Bolts (20 damage on direct hit and in a 3-block radius, does not ignite, 3s cooldown)
• Execute: instantly kills targets below 25% HP, no cooldown (cannot execute the Wild Sculk Doll boss)
• With Ender Axe: execute threshold is 30%

Aura
• End-mob pacify: endermen / endermites / shulkers cannot build aggro on you or the doll; leftover aggro is cleared automatically (the Ender Dragon is excluded)

pages.title: Crafting Recipe
pages.text:
Surround the center with 8 end stone to craft the Ender Doll Egg.

Name the egg on an anvil, then right-click the ground while holding it to summon the doll.
